newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: PdVSA sees Venezuela 1997 growth at 5.8 pct GDP.
newsitem.headline: PdVSA sees Venezuela 1997 growth at 5.8 pct GDP.

text.p: The Venezuelan economy will grow by 5.8 percent of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) in 1997, rising to 7.8 percent in 1998, according to forecasts by state oil company PdVSA, leading daily El Universal reported Monday.
Powerful oil sector growth equivalent to seven percent of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) will pull along the non-oil sector at a rate of 5.2 percent in 1997.
In 1998, however, as oil sector growth slows to three percent, the non-oil sector will boom to 7.8 percent leaving the economy as a whole to grow 8.5 percent, PdVSA forecast.
Last year, PdVSA estimates of 0.5 percent overall growth overshot a 1.6 percent fall in GDP.
